column1: # In-browser fragment profile, REPLICATION on a health-verified node, weeb-3 unfunded, 2026-08-10.
# Second sitting. Node held 108 connected / 92 connecting throughout. Retrieval budget 60000ms,
# raised from the harness default of 30000 so a slow-but-arriving large fetch still registers:
# the pilot had shown 3.5MB arriving in 48.8s, and a 30s bound would have scored that as a failure.
# ⭐ EVERY ROUND OPENS WITH A COLD CANARY (~230KB). A round whose canary misses the budget is
# DEGRADED and every measurement in it is discarded. Rounds 2 and 3 are degraded and retained here
# only as the record of where the node stopped working.
# ⛔ "over-budget" MEANS "did not complete within the budget", NOT "failed". The budget is a bound
# this harness imposes, so a row sitting at it is never quoted as a duration.
# The canary completed in 1212ms and 1007ms in those same two rounds, so the large-fragment misses
# are not attributable to node health. That is what this sitting adds over the first one.
